comments.author: @mrfitchina6234
comments.text: Roots was excellent! I literally ate half of my meals there. Super clean, tasty, and prices were good. Their dessert selection is amazing!

comments.author: @TourofDetours
comments.text: That's awesome to hear! We totally agree, Roots Café is just fantastic. Those desserts are seriously addictive, right? Glad you enjoyed it so much!

comments.author: @kalpeshgada6306
comments.text: Useful glimpse into the vegetarian, vegan food world in Da Nang. One question please - do they use fish sauce in soups and other dishes? Or are these cafes totally meat and fish-free? Thanks

comments.author: @TourofDetours
comments.text: Thank you 🙏 Those cafes that are offering totally vegan food, they dont - but it is always best to verify once before placing the order!

comments.author: @hnguyen5656
comments.text: Vietnamese vegan restaurants use a vegan version of fish sauce.

comments.author: @jameslonglove
comments.text: How are the prices? I'm daydreaming about retiring in Vietnam on a budget.

comments.author: @TourofDetours
comments.text: The prices are really good. I think compared to other popular destinations like thailand and Bali, it offers great value for money
